title: Linear Programme 11
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the domain of the function f, and the set T is the range of the function f."
The set S is called the domain of the function f, and the set T is the range of the function f .
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are termed maximization problems and those of the second sort are called minimization problems."
Problems of the first sort are termed maximization problems and those of the second sort are called minimization problems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in the statement of Taylor's Theorem to denote the k-th derivative of f evaluated at the point z."
The notation f (k)(z) is used in the statement of Taylor's Theorem to denote the k-th derivative of f evaluated at the point z.
fib: ______ is a separately continuous function, i.e., for each fixed value of t, f is continuous as a function of s, and for each fixed value of s, f is continuous in t.
Show that f is a separately continuous function, i.e., for each fixed value of t, f is continuous as a function of s, and for each fixed value of s, f is continuous in t.
______ is the open interval (0, 1), so, once again, f attains neither a maximum nor a minimum on D.
The set f (D) is the open interval (0, 1), so, once again, f attains neither a maximum nor a minimum on D.
______ is a family of points x(t) ∈ S with a ≤ t ≤ b.
A curve on S is a family of points x(t) ∈ S with a ≤ t ≤ b.
